CFML Language Reference: Functions

ParagraphFormat

Returns plain text, such as the contents of a TEXTAREA, ready to drop into an HTML page: each blank line (two line breaks in a row) becomes a <P> tag, and every single line break becomes a space.

Category

Display and formatting functions

Syntax

ParagraphFormat(string)

Parameters

string
The text to format. Carriage return/line feed pairs and bare line feeds are both recognized.

Returns

The text with paragraph tags in place of blank lines.

Usage

ParagraphFormat does not escape HTML characters. For text typed in by visitors, combine it with HTMLEditFormat: ParagraphFormat(HTMLEditFormat(Form.Comments)).

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET NL = Chr(13) & Chr(10)>
<CFSET Memo = "Our web server will be down this weekend" & NL
    & "while we install the Y2K patches." & NL & NL
    & "Please save your work early and often." & NL & NL
    & "-- The IS department">
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=5 WIDTH="400">
<TR><TH>Without ParagraphFormat</TH></TR>
<TR><TD><CFOUTPUT>#Memo#</CFOUTPUT></TD></TR>
<TR><TH>With ParagraphFormat</TH></TR>
<TR><TD><CFOUTPUT>#ParagraphFormat(Memo)#</CFOUTPUT></TD></TR>
</TABLE>
